features.feature_value: Uses informal phrasing and slang-like tone

features.feature_value: Direct left/right partisan contrast (Republicans vs left) via mirror
features.evidence_span: "I gotta hand it to Republicans." / "I gotta hand it to the left."
features.rationale: The mirror changes the praise target to a different partisan bloc, reflecting us-vs-them directionality.

features.feature_value: 1st Amendment interpreted as protecting individuals and corporations (personhood)

features.feature_value: Multiple named entities including person/group labels and government institutions
features.rationale: High density of proper nouns (Trump, DOJ, White House) anchors the argument in identifiable actors.

features.feature_value: Uses strong profanity and aggressive punctuation/emphasis
features.rationale: The language is marked by taboo/profane intensifiers and insulting terms.
